_about: Future roles Nexa can recommend. Nexa never recommends a role outside this list. 'soc' anchors the role to an O*NET occupation for its task list and AI exposure. 'outlook.direction' comes only from the cited evidence; a role with no growth signal in our sources is 'steady'. 'skills' weight: 3 essential, 2 important, 1 helpful; 'core' skills are required for the role to be shown as a match.

wef2025.name: World Economic Forum — Future of Jobs Report 2025

talentcorp2024.name: TalentCorp Impact Study on AI, Digital and Green Economy (60 emerging roles, 10 sectors)

roles.label: AI & Machine Learning Specialist
roles.summary: Builds, evaluates and deploys machine-learning and generative-AI systems.

evidence.note: AI and machine learning specialists are among the fastest-growing jobs to 2030.
AI engineers are named among Malaysia's emerging roles.

sdg.why: Expands Malaysia's own research and technological capability instead of importing it.
AI systems raise productivity across whole sectors.

entry.note: Usually a computing, engineering or maths degree, or a strong portfolio of shipped ML projects.

roles.label: Big Data Specialist
roles.summary: Designs the pipelines and warehouses that collect, clean and serve large datasets.

evidence.note: Big data specialists top the fastest-growing jobs list; data warehousing specialists also grow fast.

sdg.why: Reliable data infrastructure is what digital public and private services run on.
Data engineering capacity underpins research and innovation.

entry.note: Open to career-changers with SQL and Python skills and a portfolio.

roles.label: Data / BI Analyst
roles.summary: Turns business and public data into dashboards, insights and decisions.

evidence.note: Data analysts and scientists are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdg.why: Makes information usable and transparent for decision-makers.
Evidence-based decisions lift productivity.

entry.note: Open to career-changers; a portfolio of real analyses matters more than a degree.

roles.label: Data Scientist
roles.summary: Builds statistical and predictive models to answer business and policy questions.

evidence.note: Data analysts and scientists are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdg.why: Applies research methods to real problems.
Health, finance and public-service models improve access when built responsibly.

entry.note: Usually a degree in a quantitative field.

roles.label: Information Security Analyst
roles.summary: Protects systems and data, monitors threats and responds to incidents.

evidence.note: Information security analysts and security management specialists are among the fastest-growing jobs; networks and cybersecurity is the second fastest-growing skill.

sdg.why: Secure systems are a condition for trustworthy, accountable institutions.
Safe ICT access for businesses and citizens.

entry.note: Open with recognised security certifications and hands-on practice.

roles.label: Software & Applications Developer
roles.summary: Designs, builds and maintains applications, increasingly with AI coding assistants.

evidence.note: Software and applications developers grow both in percentage and in absolute numbers to 2030.

sdg.why: Local software capability is a core part of technological upgrading.
Digital tools drive productivity for SMEs.

entry.note: Open with a portfolio of working software.

roles.label: FinTech Engineer
roles.summary: Builds digital banking, payments and financial-inclusion products.

evidence.note: FinTech engineers are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdg.why: Expands access to banking and financial services.
Digital finance can include the unbanked and underbanked.

entry.note: Open with software skills plus payments and finance knowledge.

roles.label: Cloud / DevOps Engineer
roles.summary: Automates how software is built, deployed and run on cloud infrastructure.

evidence.note: DevOps engineers are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdg.why: Efficient cloud infrastructure uses less energy per service delivered.
Keeps digital services available.

entry.note: Open with cloud certifications and hands-on practice.

roles.label: IoT Specialist
roles.summary: Connects sensors and devices for smart factories, buildings, farms and cities.

evidence.note: Internet of Things specialists are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdg.why: Upgrades industry to cleaner, more resource-efficient processes.
Smart-city sensing reduces waste and pollution.

entry.note: Open with networking and embedded-systems practice.

roles.label: UI / UX Designer
roles.summary: Researches users and designs digital products that are easy and fair to use.

evidence.note: UI and UX designers are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdg.why: Accessible design includes older, disabled and low-literacy users.
Makes digital services usable for everyone.

entry.note: Open with a design portfolio of real projects.

roles.label: Project Manager
roles.summary: Plans and delivers projects, coordinating people, budgets and AI-enabled tools.

evidence.note: Project managers are among the jobs adding the most positions in absolute terms.

sdg.why: Delivering change projects well is how organisations actually become more productive.
Leads the upgrade projects that modernise industry.

entry.note: Open; experience leading work counts, certification helps.

roles.label: Sustainability / ESG Specialist
roles.summary: Measures and reduces an organisation's environmental footprint and prepares ESG reports.

evidence.note: Sustainability specialists are named among Malaysia's emerging roles.
Environmental stewardship is among the fastest-growing skills.

sdg.why: Directly delivers company sustainability reporting.
Builds climate capacity inside organisations.

entry.note: Open; ESG reporting and data skills are the core.

roles.label: Renewable / Solar Energy Engineer
roles.summary: Designs and evaluates solar and other renewable energy systems.

evidence.note: Renewable energy engineers are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdg.why: Increases the share of renewable energy in Malaysia's mix.
Climate mitigation in practice.

entry.note: Needs an engineering degree; professional practice requires Board of Engineers Malaysia (BEM) registration.

roles.label: Environmental Engineer
roles.summary: Solves pollution, waste and water problems with engineering and data.

evidence.note: Environmental engineers are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdg.why: Reduces the environmental impact of cities.
Cuts waste generation.

entry.note: Needs an engineering degree; professional practice requires Board of Engineers Malaysia (BEM) registration.

roles.label: Training & Development Specialist
roles.summary: Designs and runs training, including AI upskilling for colleagues.

sdg.why: Raises the number of adults with skills for decent work.
Brings lifelong technical learning into the workplace.

entry.note: Open; experience training others counts.

roles.label: Career Counsellor
roles.summary: Guides students and workers through career and reskilling decisions.

evidence.note: Social work and counselling professionals are among the jobs adding the most positions.

sdg.why: Helps young people move from education into work.
Steers people toward relevant skills.

entry.note: Practising as a counsellor in Malaysia requires registration with Lembaga Kaunselor under the Counsellors Act 1998.

roles.label: Financial Analyst
roles.summary: Analyses financial data, risk and investments, increasingly with AI tools.

sdg.why: Sound financial analysis supports access to finance.
Sustainable-finance analysis feeds company reporting.

entry.note: Open; finance or accounting background helps.

roles.label: Nursing Professional
roles.summary: Provides and coordinates patient care, using digital health tools.

evidence.note: Nursing professionals are among the jobs adding the most positions.

sdg.why: Grows the health workforce.
Universal health coverage needs nurses.

entry.note: Requires a recognised nursing diploma or degree and registration with the Nursing Board Malaysia.

roles.label: Health Information Specialist
roles.summary: Manages medical records and health data systems.

sdg.why: Accurate records make health coverage work.
Protects access to, and privacy of, information.

entry.note: Usually a diploma or degree in health information management.

roles.label: Operations Manager
roles.summary: Runs day-to-day operations and leads teams through change.

evidence.note: General and operations managers are among the jobs adding the most positions.

sdg.why: Operational excellence is productivity.
Good managers keep work decent and teams employed through change.

entry.note: Usually reached through experience leading teams.

roles.label: Secondary School Teacher
roles.summary: Teaches and mentors young people, using AI to personalise learning.

evidence.note: Secondary education teachers are among the jobs adding the most positions.

sdg.why: Grows the supply of qualified teachers.
Prepares youth with relevant skills.

entry.note: Teaching in government schools requires a recognised teaching qualification (e.g. a postgraduate diploma in education).
